{{Top|leg}}
'''Big Two''' was a term used to refer to [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] and [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]], the two largest [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturers in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It replaced the term '''Big Three''' after [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc./Legends|Serv-O-Droid, Inc.]] fell into decline.
